Kharge jokes about Gandhi's 'cowards' remark, names Scindia, Prasad

Rahul Gandhi told a gathering of Youth Congress workers that after the departure of "cowards and greedy people," only "lions" remained in the Congress. Responding to this, Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge remarked that all the leaders who left the party were "your friends," specifically mentioning Jyotiraditya Scindia and R.P. Singh.
